description_en: Queries the role, type, minor version, and active zone of each node in a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例中各节点的角色、类型、小版本和所属的可用区
name: DescribeRoleZoneInfo

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of node to query. Valid values:
0: proxy node.
This parameter is supported only for cluster and read/write splitting instances.


1: data node. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
查询的目标节点类型，取值：
0：Proxy（代理）节点。
该参数仅支持集群与读写分离架构实例。


1：数据节点，默认值
parameters.name: query_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Valid values: 10, 20, and 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页可展示的记录数，取值：10、20、50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

NodeInfo.description_en: The details of each node in the instance
NodeInfo.description_zh: 实例中各节点的详细信息

CurrentBandWidth.description_en:
The current bandwidth of the node. Unit: MB/s. This value is the sum of the default bandwidth and the additional bandwidth.
You can call the [EnableAdditionalBandwidth]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473771.html） operation to configure additional bandwidth.
You can also use this parameter to calculate the additional bandwidth. For example, if the default bandwidth of the node is 96 MB/s and this parameter returns 100, the additional bandwidth is 4 MB/s
CurrentBandWidth.description_zh:
节点当前的带宽，单位为MB/s，由节点的默认带宽和增加的带宽组成。
您可以调用[EnableAdditionalBandwidth]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473771.html）接口设置要增加的带宽。
通过本参数也可推算出增加的带宽大小，例如节点默认带宽为96 MB/s，本参数返回值为100，则增加了4 MB/s的带宽

CurrentMinorVersion.description_en: The current minor version of the node

CustinsId.description_en: The ID of the data shard node

DefaultBandWidth.description_en: The default bandwidth of the node. Unit: MB/s
DefaultBandWidth.description_zh: 节点默认的默认带宽，单位为MB/s

InsType.description_en:
Indicates whether the node is a read-only node. If the node is a read-only node, the return value is 3.
If the node is not a read-only node, this parameter is not returned
InsType.description_zh:
是否为只读节点，如果为只读节点，本参数返回值为3。
如果不是只读节点，不返回本参数

IsLatestVersion.description_en:
Indicates whether the node runs the latest minor version. Valid values:
0: The node does not run the latest version.
1: The node runs the latest version.

To upgrade the minor version, call the [ModifyInstanceMinorVersion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473777.html） operation
IsLatestVersion.description_zh:
是否为最新的小版本，返回值：
0：不是最新版本。
1：是最新版本。

如需升级小版本，请调用[ModifyInstanceMinorVersion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473777.html）接口

IsOpenBandWidthService.description_en:
Indicates whether additional bandwidth has been added to the node. Valid values:
true: No additional bandwidth has been added.
false: Additional bandwidth has been added
IsOpenBandWidthService.description_zh:
该节点是否增加了带宽，取值：
true：未增加带宽。
false：已增加带宽

NodeId.description_en: This parameter is used only for internal maintenance of the instance
NodeId.description_zh: 本参数仅作为实例内部维护使用

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:
db: data node.
proxy: proxy node.
normal: standard node. This value is returned for standard architecture instances
NodeType.description_zh:
节点类型，返回值：
db：数据节点。
proxy：代理节点。
normal：普通节点（标准架构的实例会返回该值）

Role.description_en:
The role of the node. Valid values:
master: primary node.
slave: secondary node
Role.description_zh:
节点角色，返回值：
master：主节点。
slave：备节点

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page
